verdict.rationale: Superset advertises phone/remote access ('Run your agents from your phone', 'Remote access' in paid tier) and status notifications when an agent 'finishes / waits for input,' which together enable a PM to check in and act remotely while agents keep working. However there's no explicit 'approval' UI or decision-gating workflow documented, and community feedback notes remote-session usability issues (laggy typing, rendering glitches) that could hinder quick phone-based interactions. Missing for 10: a dedicated approval/decision-gate mechanism, evidence of stable phone UX, and confirmation that approving continues agent execution rather than just viewing status.
